name: deck-validator
body: Deck validator: walks deck → slides → sections/fields recursively applying schema rules; fail-fast — stops at the first error and returns it path-qualified with hint and closest-match suggestion; formats it for terminal and browser. Walk order is fixed and deterministic: (1) kalide.yaml, (2) slide filenames (numbering, letters, label uniqueness), (3) slides in number/letter order, each top-to-bottom by line (frontmatter, body, sections, fields), (4) a final pass resolving inter-slide #label links against the full label set. Closest-match suggestions come from the shared internal/suggest helper (suggest.Closest), a cross-cutting utility used by every component that emits a "did you mean …?" error — deck-loader, slide-parser, template-library-loader, template-registry, theme-registry, cli-templates and this validator — not by the validator alone; each of those components anchors suggest.Closest, and no component claims the whole file.
